designDefectFoundAndFixed.defect: Core.execute_proposal called send(), which opens with _resolve_actor() and raises unless the caller is the account owner. When Core is invoked by the Adapter, that reverted the entire emitted transaction, so no consequence was ever recorded.
designDefectFoundAndFixed.detectedBy: the cross-contract integration test — not by unit tests, exactly as the Work Contract required
designDefectFoundAndFixed.fix: separated identity from settlement: send() is now a thin owner-gated wrapper over _settle(); execute_proposal() revalidates every economic gate and then calls the SAME _settle(). The Adapter gains no economic gate bypass.
designDefectFoundAndFixed.invariantPreserved: both entry paths share one settlement implementation, so policy, allowlist, attestation, capital and replay gates are identical
